purpose: Source-verification addendum for mechanisms still provisional in data/evidence-coverage-v1.json. This file does not mutate canonical promotion status; it records publisher-level evidence that should be reviewed against the existing promotion rule.

verificationCandidates.title: Impact of Runner Size, Gate Size, Polymer Viscosity, and Molding Process on Filling Imbalance in Geometrically Balanced Multi-Cavity Injection Molding
verificationCandidates.limitation: Study-specific four-cavity geometry, polymers and gate/runner dimensions; it supports the imbalance mechanism but no universal runner/gate sizing rule.

verificationCandidates.title: Machine Learning in Injection Molding: An Industry 4.0 Method of Quality Prediction
verificationCandidates.limitation: The classification analysis emphasized the first cavity/runner; use as multicavity pressure-supporting evidence, not direct proof of runner-balance causation.

mechanisms.reviewImpact: The first study is a strong candidate to raise publisher-verified primary measured coverage. The second strengthens cavity-specific sensing but should not be counted as an independent imbalance proof without a mechanism-specific review.

verificationCandidates.title: Out-of-Mold Sensor-Based Process Parameter Optimization and Adaptive Process Quality Control for Hot Runner Thin-Walled Injection-Molded Parts
verificationCandidates.license: open-access article; underlying raw data available on request
experimentalContext: at least four repeats per experiment
verificationCandidates.limitation: External nozzle-pressure and tie-bar sensing do not directly measure every hot-runner zone or valve-pin actual; the tested mould, material and adaptive-control logic are application-specific.

mechanisms.reviewImpact: Strong candidate to move this source from metadata-screened to publisher-verified measured evidence; a second independent study is still needed for promotion.

verificationCandidates.title: Novel approach to characterize the cross-linking effect of liquid silicone rubber via cavity pressure analysis during injection molding
verificationCandidates.publisher: Wiley Journal of Applied Polymer Science
physicalOutcome: cure/cross-linking state inferred from measured process response
verificationCandidates.limitation: Cure behavior is formulation-, tool-temperature- and geometry-specific; cavity-pressure signatures cannot be generalized to all LSR grades.

verificationCandidates.title: Liquid Silicone Rubber Headlamp Lens Injection Molding Process Optimization Based on Tie Bar Elongation and NSGA III
verificationCandidates.license: CC BY 4.0 article; raw data available on request
verificationCandidates.limitation: Optical LSR lens system and tested process window are application-specific; optimization settings are not transferable recipes.

verificationCandidates.title: Effects of Variation in Process Parameters on Cavity Pressure and Mechanical Strength of Molded Parts in LSR Injection Molding
verificationCandidates.publisher: Journal of the Korean Society of Manufacturing Technology Engineers
verificationCandidates.limitation: Older LSR formulation, mould and sensor arrangement; independent review should confirm full-text reuse/licence before canonical evidence promotion.

mechanisms.reviewImpact: Two independent modern publisher-verified measured studies now appear to satisfy the core evidence shape for LSR. Canonical promotion should still wait for independence/limitations review and exact source capture.

verificationCandidates.title: Experimental and Numerical Investigation of the Effect of Process Conditions on Residual Wall Thickness and Cooling and Surface Characteristics of Water-Assisted Injection Molded Hollow Products
verificationCandidates.publisher: Wiley/Hindawi Advances in Materials Science and Engineering
verificationCandidates.limitation: Water-assisted hollow-product geometry and equipment-specific results; does not represent gas/projectile-assisted processes.

verificationCandidates.title: A Study on the Void Formation in Residual Wall Thickness of Fluid-Assisted Injection Molding Parts
verificationCandidates.publisher: Hindawi Advances in Materials Science and Engineering
measuredEvidence: water versus silicone-oil assisted moulding experiments
verificationCandidates.limitation: Fluid, curved hollow geometry and thermal boundary conditions are specific; water, gas and projectile assistance remain separate specialist families.

verificationCandidates.title: Study of Residual Wall Thickness and Multiobjective Optimization for Process Parameters of Water-Assisted Injection Molding
verificationCandidates.limitation: Much of the parameter mapping is CFD/surrogate-model based; count only the confirmation experiments as primary measured evidence.

mechanisms.reviewImpact: Water/fluid-assisted evidence is substantially stronger than the canonical metadata-screened state suggests. Promotion of the broad combined family should still avoid treating water, gas and projectile assistance as interchangeable.

verificationCandidates.title: An Investigation to Reduce the Effect of Moisture on Injection-Molded Parts through Optimization of Plasticization Parameters
verificationCandidates.limitation: TPU/PC, tested moisture states and plasticization conditions are grade/process-specific; supplier drying limits remain controlling guidance.

verificationCandidates.title: Considerations on the Drying of the Raw Material and Consequences on the Quality of the Injected Products
verificationCandidates.limitation: Specific commercial materials and older drying equipment/process context; exact grade/drying guidance must not be generalized.

verificationCandidates.title: Study of the Influence of the Reprocessing Cycles on the Final Properties of Polylactide Pieces Obtained by Injection Molding
verificationCandidates.limitation: This source supports process-induced degradation/reprocessing rather than moisture specifically.

mechanisms.reviewImpact: Two independent measured moisture/drying studies plus independent reprocessing-degradation evidence are now publisher-located. This mechanism is a strong candidate for canonical re-review.

verificationCandidates.title: Relation between injection molding conditions, fiber length and mechanical properties for highly reinforced long fiber polypropylene
verificationCandidates.limitation: Highly reinforced long-glass-fibre PP only; raw data are not an open reusable dataset in the reviewed sources.

mechanisms.reviewImpact: Source identity and measured evidence shape are confirmed, but this mechanism still needs at least one more independent publisher-verified retained-length study before promotion.

boundary: This addendum records verification evidence only. It does not authorize raw-data reuse, does not change evidence-coverage-v1.json, and does not convert study-specific settings into universal process recipes.
